metrics.title: Evaluation metrics
metrics.rmse: Average size of the forecast error in millimetres. Lower is better.
metrics.mae: Average absolute error in millimetres. Lower is better.
metrics.csi: How often heavy rain events were correctly forecast, counting both misses and false alarms. Higher is better.
metrics.pod: The share of real heavy rain events the forecast caught. Higher is better.
metrics.far: The share of heavy rain forecasts that did not happen. Lower is better.
metrics.ets: Skill at forecasting heavy rain after removing hits that luck alone would give. Higher is better.
metrics.fss: How well the forecast matches the observed rainfall pattern over a neighbourhood. Higher is better.

error.offlineFallback: Showing demo data generated in your browser because the service is unavailable. The correction shown is a simple heuristic, not the trained models.
live.unavailableBody: The live weather provider could not be reached. This is not demo data being hidden - there is simply no current forecast to show.
live.backendUnreachableBody: The dashboard could not connect to the MonsoonAI API at all.
live.defaultNote: Live mode fetches a real forecast from Open-Meteo and runs it through the trained regime and correction models. Demo mode uses synthetic data for testing when live data is not needed.
